caption: The drawing features two figures positioned against a plain beige background. Both figures appear to be the same, depicted from different perspectives: one is lying on their back at the top of the image with knees bent, feet apart, and hands behind their head; the other is standing below, viewed from the front, with feet apart and hands also behind the head. The figures are dark-skinned with curly hair, and both wear sleeveless, loose, light-colored garments resembling a singlet and shorts, with accents in shades of pale lavender and cream. There is a clear outline around each figure, and details are rendered with shading to emphasize contours. The artist’s signature is present at the bottom right: “B. J. Fite.” No other objects or elements appear in the composition.
title: Bootjack
